title: 第16章 星劫茶香弈天外第17章 无生界里觅情魂
slug: 道骨仙锋谪世录第115章归一
content_zh:
一、星坠忘忧·域外茶香
大胤三百零九年，秋分子夜，忘忧谷突现星陨异象：
一颗拖着墨色尾焰的流星坠入竹林，撞击处露出刻满域外符文的青铜茶罐。
云栖鹤隐拂袖扫开浮土，罐身「域外·无生」四字映入眼帘，开盖时飘出的并非茶香，而是浓重的铁锈味——罐中装着十二枚「无生茶饼」，饼面压印着星空裂隙的图案。
机关鹤预警：
三只机关鹤同时发出锐鸣，齿轮运转声急骤如鼓，鹤眼中映出中天棋盘「域外」位的异动：原本空白的棋位上，正缓缓浮现一枚刻着「无」字的漆黑棋子。
楚轩行的警示：
他的虚影在茶罐上凝结，指尖划过「无生」二字：「此茶来自劫外之外的「无生界」，其民无喜无悲，无生无死——是真正的「恐惧绝缘体」。
二、正道裂痕·权术暗流
新天衡台的「权术派」秘阁内，弟子们正围着楚轩行的「权术残卷」低语，残卷边角赫然印着云栖鹤隐的「劫外生」棋子纹路：
-功法异变：
修炼者周身浮现劫外符文，眉心长出类似太昊玄渊的「恐惧触须」，却声称「已超脱七情，无惧无惑」；
-楚轩行的困惑：
他的虚影皱眉凝视弟子：「吾之权术以「民心」为基，何时变成了「灭情」之道？」
沈墨卿的调查：
他潜入秘阁，惊鸿剑剑尖挑开残卷，发现内页夹着云栖鹤隐的「惑心粉」香囊：「果然……有人在借楚轩行之名，行灭情之事。
萧素雪的琴讯：
劫心琴奏出《鹤鸣九皋》净化符文，却在接触弟子时激起黑色烟雾，烟雾中传出云栖鹤隐的冷笑：「萧仙子可知，最浓的茶香，往往藏着最苦的茶渣？」
三、鹤隐对弈·星外棋手
忘忧谷竹亭，云栖鹤隐摆下「星劫茶席」，对面坐着一位身披星轨斗篷的神秘人，手中把玩着「无」字棋子：

「无生界「无惑者」见过鹤隐先生，听闻你有「劫外三式」，可敢与吾赌一局？」
对弈三劫：
1.第一劫·无喜无悲
无惑者撒出「无生茶粉」，竹亭内顿时气息全无，云栖鹤隐的机关鹤停摆，茶香凝固在空中：「当众生不再恐惧，劫棋便失去了意义。
-破劫茶招：
云栖鹤隐咬破指尖，以血为引烹茶，茶汤竟在凝固的空气中泛起涟漪：「无喜无悲，何尝不是一种「执」？」
2.第二劫·无生无死
无惑者抛出「无生魂幡」，幡中走出亡故的太昊氏族人，他们眼神空洞，整齐诵念：「恐惧是罪，情感是孽。
-茶战玄机：
云栖鹤隐取出「劫前春」茶芽，混以楚轩行的「悔」字残片冲泡，茶汤化作春雨洒落，亡者眼中竟流出泪水：「原来……吾等早已忘了，哭与笑的滋味。
3.第三劫·无劫无棋
无惑者拍下「无」字棋子，中天棋盘剧烈震动，所有棋位开始虚化：「灭劫之道，唯有归零。
-终局之道：
云栖鹤隐将「仁」「权」「劫」「悟」四子同时推入「天元」，茶盏炸裂的碎片拼成「道心永存」四字：「劫棋可以终结，道心永远新生——这便是吾的破劫之道。
content_en:
1. Star falls and forgets worries·The fragrance of tea from abroad
In the 309th year of Dayin, on the night of autumn, a star-falling phenomenon suddenly appeared in Wangyou Valley:
A meteor trailing ink-colored tail flames fell into the bamboo forest, revealing a bronze tea can engraved with extraterrestrial runes at the impact point.
Yunqi Heyin brushed away the floating soil with a flick of his sleeves, and the four words "Outside the Territory·Wu Sheng" came into view on the jar. When he opened the lid, what came out was not the fragrance of tea, but the strong smell of rust. There were twelve "Wu Sheng Tea Cake" in the jar, and the surface of the cake was embossed with a pattern of cracks in the starry sky.
Agency Crane Warning:
The three cranes screamed at the same time, and the gears turned as fast as drums. The cranes' eyes reflected the movement of the "outside" position on the Zhongtian chessboard: on the originally blank chess position, a dark chess piece with the word "无" engraved on it was slowly emerging.
Chu Xuanying’s warning:
His shadow condensed on the tea can, and the word "inanimate" was traced across his fingertips: "This tea comes from the "inanimate world" beyond the calamity. Its people have no joy, no sorrow, no life and no death - it is a true "fear insulator."
2. Cracks in the Righteous Path and Undercurrent of Machiavellianism
In the secret pavilion of the "Power Skills Sect" in Xintian Hengtai, the disciples were whispering around Chu Xuanxing's "Power Skills Fragment". Yunqi Heyin's "Jie Waisheng" chess pattern was clearly printed on the corner of the scroll:
-Mutation of skills:
The cultivator has tribulation runes appearing all over his body, and "fear tentacles" similar to Taihao Xuanyuan grow between his eyebrows, but he claims that he has "transcended the seven emotions and has no fear or confusion";
-Chu Xuanying’s confusion:
His phantom frowned and stared at his disciples: "My political tactics are based on "people's hearts". When did it become the way of "killing love"? "
Shen Moqing’s investigation:
He sneaked into the secret pavilion, opened the fragment of the scroll with the tip of Jinghong Sword, and found Yun Qi Heyin's "Heart-Lost Powder" sachet on the inside: "Sure enough... someone is using Chu Xuanxing's name to kill love.
Xiao Suxue’s piano news:
The Jie Xin Qin played the purification rune "He Ming Jiu Gao", but when it came into contact with the disciples, it stirred up black smoke. Yunqi Heyin's sneer came from the smoke: "Fairy Xiao, do you know that the strongest tea fragrance often hides the bitterest tea residue?"
3. Heyin’s Chess Game·Extraterrestrial Chess Players
In the Bamboo Pavilion of Wangyou Valley, Yunqi Heyin set up the "Star Tribulation Tea Banquet". Opposite him sat a mysterious man wearing a star track cloak, playing with the chess piece with the word "无" in his hand:
"The Unconfused Man in the Inanimate World has met Mr. He Yin and heard that you have the "Three Tribulation Skills". Do you dare to bet with me? "
Three calamities of chess:
1. The first calamity·no joy or sorrow
The man without confusion sprinkled the "non-raw tea powder", and the bamboo pavilion suddenly lost all breath. Yunqi Heyin's mechanism crane stopped, and the fragrance of tea solidified in the air: "When all living beings are no longer afraid, the chess robbing will lose its meaning.
-Tea trick to break the tribulation:
Yunqi Heyin bit his fingertip and used the blood as a guide to make tea. The tea soup actually rippled in the solid air: "Without joy or sorrow, isn't it a kind of "attachment"?" "
2. The second calamity·no birth or death
The Unconfused One threw the "Inanimate Soul Flag", and the deceased Taihao clan members walked out of the flag. Their eyes were empty and they chanted in unison: "Fear is a sin, emotion is a sin.
- Tea war mystery:
Yunqi Heyin took out the tea buds of "Spring Before the Tribulation" and mixed it with the fragments of Chu Xuanxing's word "regret" to brew it. The tea soup turned into spring rain and fell, and tears flowed from the eyes of the deceased: "It turns out... we have long forgotten the taste of crying and laughing.
3. The third calamity: no calamity, no chess
The man without confusion took a picture of the chess piece with the word "无", and the Zhongtian chessboard shook violently, and all the chess positions began to disappear: "The only way to destroy the calamity is to return to zero.
-The way to the end:
Yunqi Heyin pushed the four pieces of "Benevolence", "Quan", "Jie" and "Wu" into "Tian Yuan" at the same time, and the broken pieces of the tea cup spelled out the four words "Tao Heart Will Live Forever": "Jie can end, Tao Heart will always be reborn - this is my way to break the tribulation."
